name: Hoar Pair
description: Touch both palms to the target in one movement so hoar creeps up from either side.

name: Mate Frost
description: Set one frost shield beside another to cover both flanks of the user at once.

name: Hoar Sense
description: Lay two fingers on frosted ground and read a matched pair of footfalls through it.

name: Pair Bite
description: Bite the same limb from either side with two cold palms until it stiffens from both sides.

name: Twin Cuff
description: Close a frozen cuff on each wrist and tie the two together with a link of hoar.

name: Hoar Salve
description: Spread a thin layer of hoar over an ally's wound so that it numbs and closes slowly and cleanly.

name: Pair Hoarfall
description: Bring both hands down together to drop a heavy fall of hoar over a wide patch in front.

name: Matched Lance
description: Cast two lances of hoar-white ice from both palms to pierce a guard from either side.

name: Hoar Mirror
description: Raise two facing sheets of hoar that bounce a qi attack between them and send it back at the sender.

name: Sleet Pair
description: Fling a handful of sleet from each hand so the stinging fall crosses at the target.

name: Sleet Cover
description: Throw a curtain of sleet before the user and withdraw behind it.

name: Dual Pellet
description: Throw two hail pellets one after the other at the same spot on the target.

name: Sleet Sense
description: Let sleet fall lightly round the user and read the gaps where bodies break its fall.

name: Crossing Sleet
description: Cross two sheets of sleet over a group so that skin is cut by both.

name: Biting Hail
description: Pelt the target's weapon hand with hail until the grip loosens and the weapon drops.

name: Cleansing Sleet
description: Pour cool sleet over an ally's tainted skin to wash away a clinging poison.

name: Hailfall
description: Bring a thick fall of hail down on one wide patch and keep it falling for several breaths.

name: Paired Barrage
description: Fire a barrage of hail from each hand in alternate bursts without a gap between them.

name: Blinding Sleet
description: Fill the air round a group with dense sleet so that none can see further than an arm's length.

name: Zero Touch
description: Close the fingers round a limb with a cold that bites to the bone.

name: Cold Floor
description: Chill the floor round the user so the footing of every near opponent turns to slick ice.

name: Thin Zero
description: Hold a plain sheet of ice at the lowest cold the user can bear before the body.

name: Deep Freeze
description: Deepen the cold on a limb until the flesh stiffens and cannot move at all.

name: Azure Edge
description: Cut with a hand rimmed in blue ice that shears through cloth and leather.

name: Frost Lull
description: Cool a failing ally's raging fever with a steady palm until the breathing evens.

name: Absolute Chill
description: Touch the chest of the target with a cold near the limit of cold so the whole body slows at once.

name: Zero Lance
description: Throw one narrow lance of blue ice at the coldest point the user can reach.

name: Zero Point
description: Bring all the cold in the body to one fingertip and touch the target so the cold passes through guard and shield alike.

name: Still Track
description: Calm the qi on both tracks of the body until neither makes a sound.

name: Hush Cut
description: Strike with one still hand while the other stays raised and cold.

name: Calm Guard
description: Hold a still guard on one track and a ready counter on the other.

name: Pause Step
description: Step so softly on a thin layer of ice that the sound of the step does not carry.

name: Stillness Bind
description: Freeze both of an opponent's shoulders in place with one still breath.

name: Twin Pause
description: Hold two cold palms close to the target until the movement of both arms slows to nothing.

name: Settle Cold
description: Steady a trembling ally with cold hands on both shoulders until the shaking stops and the pain eases.

name: Frozen Breath
description: Freeze the qi at the chest and at the dantian of a target in the same breath so no art can be called.

name: Dual Stillness
description: Lay two still palms against an incoming qi art and let both tracks of cold cancel its motion.

name: Complete Hush
description: Hold both tracks at perfect stillness so the cold stops every movement within arm's reach and the user's own.

name: Hail Dive
description: Dive upon the target with a fist of hail and strike the crown of the head.

name: Raptor Rime
description: Cool the eyes to see warm bodies against cold ground from a height.

name: Wing Frost
description: Spread frosted arms to catch a blow on a curved plane and slide it away.

name: Plunge Hail
description: Drop a fist-sized hailstone from a leap onto the head of one target.

name: Cold Lift
description: Lift off the ground on a column of cold air to cross a gap or clear a fall.

name: Hawk Mend
description: Cover a fallen ally with wings of chilled frost that close the wound and keep out the cold of shock.

name: Hailstoop
description: Plummet in one unbroken stoop and break a guard with the weight of falling hail.

name: Rime Talons
description: Strike with ten claws of rime at once to tear an armoured back.

name: Stooping Zero
description: Fall from a great height faster than the eye follows and strike with cold near absolute so the target freezes at the blow.

name: Sworn Rime
description: Swear to the wind and lay a fine rime on the palm that does not melt in a draught.

name: Wind Rime
description: Cast a fine rime on the wind into the face of the target.

name: Gale Guard
description: Turn a blow with a frosted forearm and let the following gust lift the user clear.

name: Rimed Gust
description: Send a freezing gust round a group that leaves white rime on every face and weapon.

name: Oath Anchor
description: Anchor an opponent's feet with ice at a sworn word and hold them until the word is released.

name: Wind Salve
description: Breathe a soft cold gust over an ally's wounds to numb them and close the edges.

name: Gale Lance
description: Ride a lance of rime on a hard wind straight through a shield.

name: Sworn Gale
description: Hold a gale of frost for as long as the oath is held and drive it across the whole field in front.

name: Rime Decree
description: Speak the decree of the wind and bring a deep rime down on every opponent in sight so none can lift a blade.

name: Bearing Chill
description: Take a bearing by the chill that a warm body casts and hold it.

name: Bearing Stroke
description: Close along the bearing and strike without altering the line.

name: True Frost
description: Cast a bolt of frost straight along the held bearing.

name: Course Guard
description: Hold a plate of ice square on the bearing to take whatever comes along it.

name: Bearing Cold
description: Hold a chill on the bearing so that anything crossing the line slows.

name: Level Glide
description: Glide along the bearing on a long ice slick without shifting off the line.

name: Steady Stanch
description: Run a steady chill along an ally's torn limb to stanch and numb it from end to end.

name: Cold Course
description: Fire a lance of ice that holds its bearing through wind and dark and strikes where the line ends.

name: Bearing Freeze
description: Freeze every body that stands on the line between the user and the mark.

name: Fixed Chill
description: Fix the bearing on a single opponent so that wherever they move the cold follows and holds their qi shut.

name: Vow Lock
description: Lock a frozen band round a hand at the end of a short oath.

name: Sworn Edge
description: Cut with an edge of ice once the oath is spoken.

name: Pledge Pane
description: Hold a shield of ice that is sworn to stand against one named blow.

name: Frostbound Word
description: Speak the binding word and close ice round both ankles of the target.

name: Sworn Seal
description: Seal the qi point of an arm with a rim of sworn frost that holds until the word is withdrawn.

name: Frost Pledge
description: Swear to see an ally through and hold their wound closed with a steady thin cold.

name: Vow Grip
description: Close a hand of ice on the sword arm of the opponent and hold it for as long as the oath is held.

name: Sundering Word
description: Strike a locked foe's weapon and shatter it with a spoken word of release.

name: Oath Freeze
description: Swear a wide oath over the ground and freeze the hands and feet of everyone who steps inside it before the last word.

name: Open Hail
description: Throw a fist of hail in plain sight at the target's chest.

name: Bare Chill
description: Strike with a bare cold palm that makes no attempt to hide.

name: Clear Hail
description: Turn a thrown weapon aside with a hail-hard forearm in plain view.

name: Open Eye
description: Watch the open ground with eyes cooled to see the heat of every moving body.

name: Hail Sweep
description: Sweep a wide arm of hail across the open front without cover.

name: Naked Ice
description: Stand with no screen but one clear thick sheet of ice and meet the charge directly.

name: Bitter Rinse
description: Rinse a poisoned ally's wound in bitter cold to harden the venom and drive it out.

name: Hail Volley
description: Loose a long volley of hail along the open line in plain sight with no cover left to the target.

name: Frozen Reach
description: Extend a long spear of ice across the whole open ground in one thrust.

name: Open Ruin
description: Drop a field of hail on a whole open front at once so there is no spot of cover left in it.

name: Deep Frost
description: Draw deep stored cold from the ground below the stance into the legs.

name: Sole Chill
description: Send the stored cold up through the ground to numb the soles of a near foe.

name: Frozen Stance
description: Sink the stance into frozen ground to take a push without giving a step.

name: Cold Share
description: Let an ally stand on the user's frozen ground and draw the same strength into their feet.

name: Deep Rime
description: Strike with a fist rimed in deep cold drawn up from below.

name: Rising Cold
description: Burst the stored cold up through the ground under a group.

name: Stored Mend
description: Draw stored cold into an ally's wound to stop the bleeding and set the skin firm.

name: Soil Lock
description: Freeze the soil round the feet of an opponent to a hardness no kick can break.

name: Deep Pull
description: Pull the warmth from a foe's legs through the ground until they cannot stand.

name: Deep Share
description: Share the stored deep cold among allies so each draws the same steady power for several breaths.

name: Bedrock Cold
description: Break open the cold below the ground and let it rise through the whole field freezing every foot that stands on it.
